entities.name: Martin Petiška
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martin Petiška, also known by the pseudonyms Eduard Martin, Eduard P. Martin and Martin P. Edwards, is a Czech writer, poet, playwright and publisher. He is the son of the writer Eduard Petiška. He is the author of more than ninety titles.
